integrity: Exact elementary proof and standalone finite arithmetic checks; finite enumeration is not used as an infinite proof; original theorem retains bibliographic risk of general character-theoretic coverage.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative chain rings of length at least two and single commutator word only; does not classify isomorphism types or non-chain rings. Nonidentity central fibers are new target; field and zero-fiber precedent credited.
title: Valuation strata of prescribed Heisenberg commutators over finite chain rings
